BuildingTypeClass::ReadINI -- parses one building's [section] into the type object.
Verified 2026-08-05, writer pass (Foundation= handling only; the rest of this large body
was not audited in this pass).

*** ADDRESS CORRECTION. *** The 2026-08-05 investigation cited this function as
"BuildingTypeClass__ReadINI @ 0x004610d8". That is wrong: 0x004610d8 is an address INSIDE
the body, not the entry. The function is 0x0045fe50 and its body runs to 0x00464a62.

FOUNDATION= IS READ TWICE, both times from the INI object at 0x887180 -- never from the
rules object:
  00461225  MOV ECX,[EBP+0xef0]   ; the CURRENT field value ...
  0046122b  PUSH ECX              ; ... is passed as the INI DEFAULT
  0046122c  PUSH 0x81a734         ; key "Foundation" (read 2026-08-05)
  00461231  PUSH EDI              ; section A
  00461232  MOV ECX,0x887180      ; the INI object
  00461237  CALL 0x00474da0
  00461248  MOV [EBP+0xef0],EAX   ; store first result
  0046123c  PUSH EAX              ; first result becomes the default for the second read
  0046123d  PUSH 0x81a734         ; "Foundation" again
  00461242  PUSH EBX              ; section B (different section)
  00461243  MOV ECX,0x887180      ; same INI object
  0046124e  CALL 0x00474da0

WHY THIS MATTERS: because the CURRENT field value is passed as the default, an absent
Foundation= key leaves the constructor's value in place (index 0 = 1x1, set at
0x0045df13). The two reads are a base-section-then-override pair keyed on two different
sections of the same INI object.

0x887180 is the same INI object used for art lookups by BuildingTypeClass__LoadVisualAssets
(nine references) and by ObjectTypeClass__ReadINI at 005f9587 / 005f95af; it is pushed to
the type-loading loop from Init_Game at 0052c9e6. Its identity as the ART ini specifically
is strongly indicated but was NOT proven byte-for-byte this pass -- treat the object's
NAME as UNCHECKED while treating "both reads use the same object, and it is the one the
art paths use" as verified.
